contentBlocks.body: A pure helper returns the same output for the same input and avoids changing outside state. Pure helpers are easier to test and review.

**Worked example.** Every value affecting this calculation is an input. The function returns a result without changing an external total or reading the current time. The same inputs therefore make a repeatable test.
Reading a changing global value makes the same call behave differently. Mutating an input object also affects the caller.

**Try a small change.** List the inputs a discount helper needs so it does not depend on global settings.

Then complete the independent check below without copying the example. Explain the boundary case in words before running it.

knowledgeItems.prompt: Why are pure helper functions easier to test?

choices: they always run in the browser
same input gives the same output
payload.answer: same input gives the same output
